title: Travely Premium Suitcase XL — 120 L Hard-Shell Trolley
short_description: Large hard-shell trolley with 120 litres of space, 4 spinner wheels and a TSA combination lock.
long_description: The Travely Premium suitcase in size XL offers 120 litres of space and measures 52 x 29 x 77 cm. The hard shell is made of ABS and polycarbonate and is water repellent. It rolls on 4 spinner wheels and has a telescopic handle, 2 carry handles, 2 compartments and 2 pockets. The TSA combination lock secures the contents. At 5.76 kg empty weight it is made for longer trips. Colour: deep sea blue.
